title: gym_membership_parkour_ban
display_title: My gym charged me $4,000 for a membership I cancelled three years ago
beats: My gym billed my card $4,014 for a membership I cancelled in 2021 -- and they had proof I cancelled it.
I called, and the manager said the system 'auto-reactivates' accounts if you're seen on their security cameras doing unauthorized activity.
Turns out I'd been filming parkour lines off their climbing wall and lobby railings for a YouTube short two years ago, without a membership.
Their policy: unauthorized facility use gets billed retroactively at full membership rate, backdated to your last visit, no cap.
I paid it in a lump sum out of spite, then posted the receipt next to the video that got me billed for it.
It has 2 million views now and the gym still hasn't responded to my emails asking for a refund.
AITAH for turning my own fine into content?
